category.name: Cloud and hosting
category.description: Cloud providers, serverless and edge platforms, and site hosting an agent can deploy to and manage.

entries.name: AWS APIs
entries.auth_hint: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) signed request using IAM access key/secret or STS temporary credentials
entries.free_tier: new accounts get up to $200 in credits plus free usage of 90+ services for up to 6 months; some services also have a perpetual Always Free tier
entries.desc_en: An agent can provision and control thousands of AWS resources (compute, storage, databases, ML) via SDKs/CLI/REST.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of distinct service APIs, each with its own IAM scoping, rate limits, and regional availability; no single unified OpenAPI spec.

entries.name: Azure APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <access_token> (Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD OAuth2)
entries.free_tier: 12 months of select free services plus $200 credit for 30 days for new accounts; many services also have a permanent always-free monthly amount
entries.desc_en: An agent can deploy and manage Azure resources (compute, storage, databases, AI) across resource-provider REST APIs.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of resource-provider APIs, each independently versioned (api-version query param required); the Azure MCP repo moved from Azure/azure-mcp (archived) to microsoft/mcp.

entries.name: Cloudflare API
entries.free_tier: free with any Cloudflare account; API access itself is free, manages both free and paid Cloudflare products
entries.desc_en: An agent can manage DNS, Workers, zones, WAF/security rules, and caching for Cloudflare accounts programmatically.
entries.notes: Global rate limit ~1,200 requests/5 min per user; per-IP limit ~200 req/sec; GraphQL Analytics API has a separate cost-based limit. Legacy X-Auth-Key global key auth also exists but is discouraged.

entries.name: Fly.io Machines API
entries.free_tier: no perpetual free tier; pay-as-you-go billing with trial credit for new accounts
entries.desc_en: An agent can create, start, stop, and destroy Fly.io Machines (lightweight VMs) programmatically via REST.
entries.notes: The official MCP server ships under Fly.io's Sprites product, adjacent to but distinct from the core Machines API.

entries.name: Google Cloud APIs
entries.auth_hint: Authorization: Bearer <OAuth2 access token> (service account or Application Default Credentials); API keys for select public APIs
entries.free_tier: free trial credit for new customers plus an Always Free tier with perpetual no-cost limits on select products
entries.desc_en: An agent can create and manage Google Cloud resources (compute, storage, data, AI/ML) via REST, gRPC, or client libraries.
entries.notes: Umbrella platform: hundreds of distinct service APIs, each with its own scopes/quotas; many APIs require explicit per-project enabling. MCP Toolbox for Databases is Google's main official MCP offering (Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, BigQuery, Spanner).

entries.name: Netlify API
entries.free_tier: free Starter plan; API usage subject to account plan limits
entries.desc_en: An agent can create/manage sites, trigger and monitor deploys, and configure DNS, domains, and env vars.
entries.notes: Rate limits: 500 req/min general, 3 deploys/min (100/day). Tokens are invalidated on password reset.

entries.name: Render API
entries.free_tier: free static sites; free web services that spin down after inactivity
entries.desc_en: An agent can create and manage Render services, trigger deployments, and configure databases and env vars.
entries.notes: OpenAPI spec endpoint/tag names may change over time even though the API itself stays backward compatible. Render's official MCP server supports potentially destructive operations (env var changes, triggering deploys).

entries.name: Tencent EdgeOne Pages (Makers)
entries.auth_hint: API token created in the EdgeOne Makers console (API Token tab), passed to the MCP server or CLI as EDGEONE_PAGES_API_TOKEN; the hosted HTML-sharing MCP needs no token
entries.free_tier: Free plan (stated as permanent): 40 projects, 500 builds/month, 3M Edge Function and 1M Cloud Function invocations/month, 5 GB storage, 1 GB KV, 1 GB Blob.
entries.desc_en: Lets an agent deploy HTML pages, static sites and full-stack apps with edge functions to EdgeOne and get back a public URL.
entries.notes: Renamed EdgeOne Makers. No public REST API: use the MCP server (@edgeone/makers-mcp) or EdgeOne CLI. The remote endpoint's no-login tool deploys a single HTML page; projects need the token.

entries.name: Vercel API
entries.free_tier: free on Hobby plan; some resources/endpoints require Pro/paid plan
entries.desc_en: An agent can create deployments, manage projects/domains/env vars, and query analytics and logs.
entries.notes: Vercel MCP (Beta) is remote/OAuth-based; write actions like deployments or purchases require explicit OAuth consent.
